CREATE TABLE conversation_run_inputs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	agent_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	run_id UUID, 
	client_request_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	input_payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	attachment_ids JSON NOT NULL,

	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_conversation_run_inputs_binding CHECK ((status IN ('pending', 'canceled') AND run_id IS NULL) OR (status IN ('claimed', 'failed') AND run_id IS NOT NULL)),

	CONSTRAINT ck_conversation_run_inputs_revision_position CHECK (revision >= 1 AND position >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_conversation_run_inputs_run UNIQUE (run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES conversation_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(agent_id) REFERENCES agents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
